title: Silencing Empowerment, Allowing Bigotry: Auditing the Moderation of Hate Speech on Twitch
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful speech directed at religious groups, as part of a broader audit of moderation against hate based on protected characteristics like race, ethnicity, and religion.
findings: The filter for Race, Ethnicity, and Religion (RER) had the lowest overall recall at 12.3%, making it the least effective at flagging hateful content among the categories tested. Hate speech related to Islamophobia and anti-Semitism was shown to have very low detection rates. While low in recall, the RER filter was found to be the most precise.
references: 47 U.S.C. § 230. 1996. Protection for private blocking and screening of offensive material. Available at: https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/47/230.
